nodes.name: Sklearn Impute Iterative Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level IterativeImputer estimator-selection, callback-boundary, fit/transform-payload, and fitted-state atoms above per-feature estimator fit/predict callbacks, posterior sampling, convergence, and mutable imputation-loop execution.

nodes.name: iterative_public_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose the public experimental IterativeImputer estimator name useful for framework-level preprocessing selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: iterative_public_callback_boundary
nodes.description: Return the per-feature estimator fit/predict callback boundary represented by public IterativeImputer execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed callback-boundary label for IterativeImputer.

nodes.name: iterative_public_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level IterativeImputer routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for IterativeImputer.

nodes.name: iterative_public_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public IterativeImputer fit payload for dense inputs with missing values without executing per-feature estimator callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, fit_params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense inputs and packages references without fitting per-feature estimators.

nodes.name: iterative_public_transform_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public IterativeImputer transform payload without replaying fitted imputation triplets.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense transform input and packages references, leaving imputation replay to sklearn.

nodes.name: iterative_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public IterativeImputer object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: iterative_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted iteration counts, per-feature imputation triplet counts, estimator types, neighbor counts, limit-vector shapes, and initial-imputer metadata after deferred IterativeImputer execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom summarizes the already-fitted imputation sequence in time proportional to sequence length.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 and Case 4 public IterativeImputer shell over per-feature estimator fit/predict, posterior sampling, convergence, and mutable imputation-loop boundaries
limitations: Per-feature estimator fitting, per-feature prediction, posterior sampling, neighbor selection, convergence evaluation, feature assignment, transform replay, indicator concatenation, and mutable imputation-loop execution remain delegated behavior.
The shell models dense public API routing and compact fitted-sequence metadata, not the experimental IterativeImputer training or transform loop.
